source.track: GCE A Level · ages 16–18 · three core study areas and six specialist study areas assessed through two examined components plus a non-exam production

note: Units open with the specification's three core study areas, then follow Components 1–3 and their lettered sections in teaching order. Film-form craft anchors the foundational and intermediate lessons; the specialist areas (spectatorship, ideology, narrative, auteur, critical debates, filmmakers' theories) feed the advanced and expert lessons.
